name: A-l13-edit-s201-v2
prompt: <image1> shows a creature at its newborn stage. Draw the same creature grown into its young stage. Body change: make the head much smaller in relation to the body; the body becomes long and low like a young badger; it now stands and trots on four clearly visible sturdy legs; a short fluffy tail points up. Keep from <image1>: the face with its eyes, small mouth and coral cheeks, wide rounded leaf-shaped ears that hang slightly sideways, and a cream blaze running from the nose up over the forehead, the apricot and cream colors and the flat two-tone style without outlines. One creature, full body, three-quarter front view, plain flat pale mint background.
